description:
750W Rated power 2000W Peak Power Brushless Hub Motor | Unmatched Torque & Acceleration
750WRaterd power 2000W Peak Power: Delivers consistent power for long rides while providing a 2000W burst for rapid acceleration and steep climbs.
Smooth & Linear Acceleration: Engineered for the "smooth ride" you love—no jerky starts, just seamless power delivery from 0 to top speed.
High-Torque Performance: Conquer hills and headwinds without breaking a sweat, thanks to optimized internal gearing.
50 Miles of Range
High-Capacity 960Wh Battery: Massive energy density delivers up to 50 miles of range, providing the ultimate "range anxiety" solution for long-distance commutes and weekend adventures.
Sleek Semi-Integrated Design: High-performance power hidden in a semi-invisible frame, maintaining a clean, aerodynamic aesthetic without sacrificing battery life..
20*4.0 Fat tire -off all roads
Ultimate Grip & Stability: The 4-inch wide footprint provides maximum traction on sand, snow, mud, and gravel, ensuring a stable ride where standard tires fail.
Superior Shock Absorption: The high-volume rubber acts as a secondary suspension, soaking up bumps and vibrations for that "riding on a cloud" feel.
Stop Shorter, Ride Harder: 180mm Pro-Grade Hydraulic Braking
Precision Stopping Power: Engineered for 35 MPH speeds, our hydraulic system provides significantly shorter stopping distances compared to traditional mechanical brakes.
Effortless Control: Experience smooth, "one-finger" braking that delivers instant response and superior modulation, ensuring you stay in total command of your ride
Smart Control Center: Your High-Tech Cockpi
Full-Color Clarity: Keep track of your speed, battery life, and mileage at a glance—even under direct sunlight.
Effortless Cruise Control: Press once to lock in your speed. Relax your wrist and enjoy the glide on long, straight paths.
Intelligent PAS Modes: Seamlessly switch between 5 power levels to match your mood and the terrain.
Full Suspension
Dual-Suspension Mastery: The synergy of a high-response Hydraulic Front Fork and a Rear Horst-link system delivers a "floating" ride, neutralizing heavy impacts on uneven terrain.
Active Horst-Link Geometry: Engineered to decouple braking forces from suspension movement, ensuring your rear wheel maintains maximum traction and control, even on high-speed descents.
